oneOf.title: granite-4.1-8b
oneOf.description:
An 8b-parameter instruction-tuned LLM in full bf16 precision. In this project, it powers tasks such as prompt-based reasoning, summarization, answer generation, and other LLM-driven functionalities.

**Model strengths**: Reliable instruction-following, natural conversation, strong reasoning, and enterprise-grade accuracy.

**Supported Languages**: English (primary), Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and 100+ more.

oneOf.title: granite-4.1-8b-fp8
oneOf.description:
An 8b-parameter instruction-tuned LLM quantized to fp8. Uses less memory (~8GB vs ~16GB) and is faster on hardware with native fp8 support (e.g. AMD MI300X).

**Model strengths**: Reliable instruction-following, natural conversation, strong reasoning, and enterprise-grade accuracy.

**Supported Languages**: English (primary), Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, and 100+ more.

apiKey.title: API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional API key for securing the vLLM service. If provided, **store it securely**—you will need to enter this key when accessing the Question and Answer service. Leave empty to disable authentication.

tensorParallelSize.title: Tensor parallel size
tensorParallelSize.description: Number of AMD GPUs to use for tensor parallelism. Must match the number of GPU devices made available to the container.
